title: Low-depth whole genome sequencing as a complementary approach for detecting clinically relevant variants in hearing loss
task: Evaluate low-depth whole genome sequencing (10x) for detecting clinically relevant variants in hearing loss
key_results: 10x WGS detected all previously reported causal/clinically relevant variants in hearing-loss genes; aggregate exonic and splice-region variants not significantly different from 30x WGS; detected structural and mitochondrial variants
comments: Low-depth WGS provides cost-effective alternative for focused disease-gene analysis, though reduced sensitivity for novel variants and noncoding regions may limit utility for rare disease discovery.

High-confidence calls in established disease-associated genes

title: Complexity of disconnection dynamics during grain boundary migration
